newsitem.title: USA: Natl Geographic, Pearson cut CD-ROM deal.
newsitem.headline: Natl Geographic, Pearson cut CD-ROM deal.

text.p: The National Geographic Society, publisher of National Geographic magazine, is expected to unveil a $40 million partnership deal on Wednesday to produce a line of CD-ROMs, a company spokeswoman said.
National Geographic Interactive, the society's technology division, is set to announce the agreement with Pearson Plc unit, Mindscape, to publish CD-ROMs through 2000.

The titles will be published in four different languages, English, Japanese, French and German. The first of five titles scheduled for 1997, "The National Geographic Societ's First 108 Years," is set for a Summer 1997 release.
The title will include all magazine articles and pictures categorized decade by decade, the spokeswoman said.
The National Geographic Society is the world's largest nonprofit scientific and educational organization with 9.0 million members worldwide.
Mindscape, located in Novato, Calif., has been developing and publishing consumer software for over 15 years.
